datasets.name: PBFTransactions
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  po.id as num,po.name as opname,po.fromfilialtofilial as fromfiltofil,po.paymentno,
  p.ID,po.username,po.clientaccid,PO.operationtype AS optype,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,ad.filial as debitfilial,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,ac.filial as creditfilial,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Name,p.VAL_ACC,
  0 as status
FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    LAZYTRANSACTION p,
    pbf_operations po,
    pbf_transactions pt
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate  and
    (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
          not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
          or
          (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))
    and po.id = pt.operid 
    and p.id = pt.TRANSACTIONID 
    and pt.hdate = :TransactionDate

union


SELECT
  po.id as num,po.name as opname,po.fromfilialtofilial as fromfiltofil,po.paymentno,
  p.ID,po.username,po.clientaccid,PO.operationtype AS optype,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,ad.filial as debitfilial,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,ac.filial as creditfilial,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Name,p.VAL_ACC,
  1 as status
FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    provarch p,
    pbf_operations po,
    pbf_transactions pt
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
          not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
          or
          (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))
    and po.id = pt.operid 
    and p.id = pt.TRANSACTIONID 
    and pt.hdate = :TransactionDate

--order by :orderfield

datasets.name: PBFReportDs
datasets.sql:
select * from 
(select BANK as pe_BANK,
        KOD_B as pe_KOD_B,
        INN as pe_inn,
        KRNO as pe_KRNO,
        SWIFT as pe_SWIFT,sedr,BUHALTR,
        PBF_TRANSACTION.get_accnoByType(:acctype1, a.kod_fil, :clientaccid, 'SELF',:opid) as pc_accno,
        PBF_TRANSACTION.get_valByAccID(:clientaccid) as valute
        from filialinfo a
where kod_fil = PBF_TRANSACTION.get_filialCode(null,:usr) )a,

(SELECT  a.re_bank, a.re_kod_b, a.re_inn, a.re_krno,a.re_swift, a.rc_name, a.rc_account, a.rc_inn  FROM  pbf_beneficiars a where OPERTYPE = 'AZERCELL'),


(SELECT   a.stamp, a.chiefsign, a.accoutantsign
  FROM pbf_othersettings a where filialid=PBF_TRANSACTION.get_filialCode(null,:usr)) c,

(select paymentno from pbf_operations where id = :opid) d
